_about: look: the whole doll lifted out of the dark room (gain multiplies, gamma below 1 opens the shadows) and a warm rim of rim_color on the side that faces rim_dir (towards the lamps, up), rim_px room pixels wide, rim 0..1 (D81). sheet_parts: true draws the parts from parts_dir/full with mipmaps and smoothing, sharp at any camera zoom (D84); false draws the parts baked to the game size, pixel by pixel. The heroine as a cutout doll (task Д5, D77). Parts are cut from docs/art/heroine/character_parts_hq.jpg by tools/cut_heroine_parts.py. Every length is in pixels of the part pictures; scale turns them into game pixels. at: where the joint sits in the parent part's picture (for a part without parent: from the feet, the rig's origin). pivot: the same joint in the part's own picture. z: drawing order, higher in front. size: draw the part this many times larger than on the sheet (default 1). far: the far side of the body, drawn darker. Poses give each part's angle in degrees, positive clockwise; lift moves the whole body up in part pixels. soles: points of the boot soles; every pose is lowered or raised so the lowest of them stands on the floor. run: the cycle of poses by the distance walked (cycle_px game pixels for all keys, so the feet do not slide), min_speed_px: slower is standing, blend_seconds: how fast she goes from one pose to the next. air: in the air the pose blends from rise to fall by the vertical speed (blend_speed_px: the speed of the full fall pose), and the body keeps its pelvis where it stands in idle instead of the soles. overlays: short poses laid over the run or idle for the parts they name — press (E) and land; seconds in all, in_seconds and out_seconds to blend in and out; land plays only after a fall faster than min_speed_px. exit: the walk out of the doorway at the start of a level: the exit pose and the dark tint fade out over the walk-in. light: the gauntlet's light on her own body only (D76), forward and rewind strength, radius_px in game pixels around the strip's center, and under Shift waves of the time colour that run over her body into the gauntlet (wave_px apart, wave_hz, width as a part of wave_px).
